sourceSteps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将杠铃放在上背部。
用小腿将脚跟抬离地面，尽可能高。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
acceptedReferenceObservation: Wider fixed composition retains head and both plate ends during loaded calf raise. Start heels flat; endpoint raises heels while forefeet remain planted. Bar remains across upper back, both paws keep their grip, knees/hips stay almost straight and tail does not bear weight.
renderingAssumption: The illustrated barbell uses modest identical black plates; no physical mass or exact heel-rise height is claimed.
